title: CoreSnapshot
description: Payload alternatives embedded in the existing snap message, not a new frame.

primary_connection.description: The backend's primary active connection; never infer it from map order.

stale.description: Retained last-good data may be displayed but is visibly stale.

dispatched.description: False only when the daemon proves no UI provider received the call.

Entities_Device.description: Collections use stable IDs and explicit ordering; never arrays of entities.

EntityId.description: Opaque daemon-issued identifier. Never interpret as a path, address or command.

Entities_AccessPoint.description: Collections use stable IDs and explicit ordering; never arrays of entities.

name.description: Display text only. SSID bytes and credentials stay with NetworkManager.

frequency_mhz.description: Radio frequency in MHz; omitted when the backend does not report it.

Entities_Connection.description: Collections use stable IDs and explicit ordering; never arrays of entities.

ssid.description: Saved Wi-Fi profiles only (N0042). Display text; secrets are never published.

last_used.description: Seconds since the Unix epoch of the last successful activation; omitted if never.

Entities_BluetoothAdapter.description: Collections use stable IDs and explicit ordering; never arrays of entities.

Entities_BluetoothDevice.description: Collections use stable IDs and explicit ordering; never arrays of entities.

rssi.description: N0047: signal strength in dBm while the adapter sees the device (discovery), else absent.

prompt.description: Present only while a pairing started by `bluetooth.pair` waits for the user.

name.description: Device name for the prompt text.

timeout_ms.description: The prompt is withdrawn and the pairing fails with `timeout` after this long.

PairingKind.description:
N0045: what the pairing agent is waiting for. `display` and `confirm` carry the code shown
on both screens (not a secret); a typed PIN or passkey travels only in
`bluetooth.pair.respond` and is never published.

oneOf.description: Ask the user for the device's PIN code (up to 16 characters).
Ask the user for the six-digit passkey the device shows.
Ask whether `code` matches the code on the device.
Ask whether the device (or one of its services) may connect.
Show `code`; the user types it on the device. No response is expected.

Entities_PowerProfile.description: Collections use stable IDs and explicit ordering; never arrays of entities.

BatteryState.description: Battery readback is independent of profile selection. Missing is unknown.

state.description:
UPower state: 0 unknown, 1 charging, 2 discharging, 3 empty,
4 fully charged, 5 pending charge, 6 pending discharge.

Entities_AudioNode.description: Collections use stable IDs and explicit ordering; never arrays of entities.

volume.description:
Actual linear backend volume, 0=silent, 1=100%; may exceed 1 externally.
The Nacre setter separately retains its existing 0..1 policy.

readback.description:
Authoritative when present. Legacy volume/muted are readings only when
ready=true; unavailable readback must never be displayed as zero/false.

target.description: Current target for a playback/capture stream, if known.

AudioReadback.description: Independently available backend readings. Unknown members are omitted.

perceptual_volume.description: Cube root of linear volume, matching the existing Bead slider.

history.description: A bounded window onto the existing history store; no new retention policy.

popup_order.description: Service-selected popup eligibility. Missing is unknown, not all active.

history_count.description: Total retained history including nontransient active notices, not window size.

history_more.description: Whether older closed records exist beyond this bounded history window.

Entities_Notification.description: Collections use stable IDs and explicit ordering; never arrays of entities.

body.description: Display content, never evaluated as code; existing markup policy applies.

created_ms.description: Unix milliseconds; no clock formatting in the service.

image_path.description: Local cached file only, no remote URL or inline image payload.

default_action.description:
Opaque ID of the freedesktop default action, when present. Null means
card activation has no default action; the native key stays private.

timeout_ms.description: Resolved policy timeout; zero means no automatic expiry.

remaining_ms.description:
Remaining lifetime at the last service transition, including hover pause.
Eligibility/expiry belongs to the service, not a client countdown.

revision.description: Producer revision; absent in legacy snapshots.

expires_ms.description: Projected Unix-ms deadline; producer owns monotonic expiry.

Entities_NotificationAction.description: Collections use stable IDs and explicit ordering; never arrays of entities.

serial.description: Changes for repeated equal-valued requests; scoped to the daemon boot.

expires_ms.description: Absolute same-host Unix milliseconds. Expired snapshots never replay an OSD.

Entities_TrayItem.description: Collections use stable IDs and explicit ordering; never arrays of entities.

icon_path.description: Decoded pixmaps stay in a worker/cache. Never publish pixel arrays.

Entities_TrayMenuEntry.description: Collections use stable IDs and explicit ordering; never arrays of entities.

children.description: Child IDs into the same menu map, not nested entity arrays.

refreshing.description: A refresh was accepted and is running off the readiness path.

checked.description: Unix seconds, matching the existing helper's checked field.

latitude.description: Resolved city coordinates, shared with the daemon photo source (N0057).

temperature.description: Temperatures in degrees Celsius, wind in km/h, pressure in hPa.

Entities_WeatherHour.description: Collections use stable IDs and explicit ordering; never arrays of entities.

Entities_WeatherDay.description: Collections use stable IDs and explicit ordering; never arrays of entities.

refreshing.description: A background refresh is running; callers need not wait for package mirrors.

count.description: None means unknown, including a failed refresh; never treat as zero.

Entities_CalendarEvent.description: Collections use stable IDs and explicit ordering; never arrays of entities.

start.description: Unix seconds; day labels are interpreted in the configured local timezone.

Entities_LyricLine.description: Collections use stable IDs and explicit ordering; never arrays of entities.

LyricLine.description: Existing dashboard-media enrichment result; not a new playback-control API.

cpu_percent.description: Whole-machine busy share in [0,100] over the last sample interval.

network.description:
Oldest first, at most 32 samples; absent or empty means no sample yet.
A time series, not entities: order is time, items have no identity.

Entities_SystemProcess.description: Collections use stable IDs and explicit ordering; never arrays of entities.

Entities_SystemDisk.description: Collections use stable IDs and explicit ordering; never arrays of entities.

SystemMemory.description: Physical memory in bytes; `used` excludes reclaimable cache (MemAvailable).

SystemGpu.description: Busiest GPU. Each member is independently optional; omitted means unknown.

SystemHost.description:
What the host card shows. Every member is independently optional; omitted means
unknown. Static for a subscription: clients count uptime from `boot_ms`.

user.description: Login name of the daemon's user.

uptime_s.description: Seconds since boot when the subscription started.

boot_ms.description: Boot time in Unix milliseconds; uptime now is `now - boot_ms`.

NetworkSample.description: One interval rate in **bytes per second** (the `_bps` names are fixed by Bead B0024).

active.description: The player the daemon considers current; clients may let the user override.

Entities_Player.description: Collections use stable IDs and explicit ordering; never arrays of entities.

Player.description: One MPRIS player. Text is display-only and bounded; unknown values are omitted.

art_path.description: Absolute path of a private cached copy; remote URLs never cross the protocol.

position_ms.description:
Position at `position_updated_ms`. While `playing`, clients extrapolate
locally; the daemon republishes on seek, status and track changes only.

position_updated_ms.description: Unix milliseconds of the position reading; present exactly with `position_ms`.
